verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs describe SSH/JupyterLab access to instances and firewall rules to control incoming traffic (implying ability to open/restrict ports), plus private high-speed networking (GPUDirect RDMA) between nodes in 1-Click Clusters and MK8s. However, there's no explicit documentation of general-purpose port exposure/forwarding for serving custom applications, nor of private networking between arbitrary standalone instances (only within clusters). Missing for 10: explicit custom port-forwarding/exposure workflow, private VPC-style networking between non-cluster instances, and independent confirmation these features work as described.
